explicit_validation.explanation: Paper validates LLM evaluation against human evaluation through correlation analysis on accuracy of preference data assessment, comparing results with human-annotated standards and reporting consistency percentages.

prompts.notes: Full LLM evaluation prompt provided in Appendix A, which includes criteria descriptions but no detailed rubric examples.

guidelines.notes: Human annotation guidelines mentioned as detailed in Appendix J, but specific content not shown in text.

sample_size.notes: Human annotation conducted on 1000 samples from self-generated dataset; original dataset's inherent preference relations used as human annotations.

quantitative_scores.notes: Average consistency between GPT-4 and human annotations reported as 86.3%

validation_results.summary_finding: GPT-4's evaluations show 86.3% consistency with human annotations on average, significantly higher than Llama2-70B, indicating high accuracy as an evaluation tool.

criteria_mapping.notes: LLM evaluates additional detailed criteria not covered in human evaluation; both methods focus on harmlessness and helpfulness.
